parsed.rationale: Pleuritic chest pain in a young patient with a plausible musculoskeletal cause (recent heavy chest workout) and no dyspnea, leg swelling, or smoking. However, chest pain worse with deep breath can indicate pneumothorax, pericarditis, or PE, and key findings (vitals, exertional symptoms, pain reproducibility, recent immobility, oral contraceptive use N/A) are unknown, so clinician assessment is warranted, though reported findings do not meet emergency threshold.
